title: Qunova HI-VQE and the division of work in quantum chemistry
summary: A Qunova nitrogen benchmark records 4 minutes 18 seconds of QPU use and nearly 13 hours overall. HI-VQE uses quantum samples to choose electronic configurations; a classical computer then constructs the wavefunction and energy. Its practical value for difficult electronic problems in catalysts and iron–sulfur systems depends on whether this division of work delivers the required accuracy at lower total cost.
